extract: Folake Aremu  (10 October 1960 – 5 January 2021), popularly known as Oriṣabunmi  was a Nigerian veteran actress. She was known for her roles as a priestess, pacifist, white witch or the good witch in some of her movies. Aremu is considered one of Yoruba's most talented actresses. She was nominated for the Most  Searched Actress award posthumously at the 2021 NET Honours. She died on 5th of January 2021 in her Ibadan residence.
